integrity: Complete self-contained derivation; numerical values are cross-checks, not an infinite proof. No independent validation or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: Complex Hilbert operators only; exact essential-norm equality assumes an isometry with nonzero wandering subspace. Only dyadic pair differences, not full variation operators, are considered. An older oscillation paper was available only by abstract; broader priority remains subject to independent checking.
title: Sharp dyadic Cesàro oscillation and essential norms for nonunitary Hilbert isometries
